chunks: Sa‘īd ibn Yasār narrated from Abī ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in emancipating the child of zina.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abī ‘Abdillāh, a title of Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; indicates transmission of the report
key_terms.سَعِيدُ: Sa‘īd, the named narrator in the sanad
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; a phrase indicating permissibility
key_terms.يُعْتَقَ: be emancipated; be set free from bondage

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to emancipate a child born out of wedlock in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling that there is no objection to emancipating a child born out of wedlock. It indicates permissibility in this matter and addresses the legal status of such an act within fiqh.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3528 - It is narrated from Sa'id ibn Yasar, who said:
"Abu Abdullah (as), said:
'There is no harm in emancipating the child born out of wedlock.' "
